items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the exact EDIT TARGET, an empty house-floor shell; image2 is the approved room STYLE reference; image3 is the finished rental shell MATERIAL QUALITY comparison. Upgrade townhouse-t1 noticeably from simple broad flat color regions to detailed semi-realistic painted architectural materials, matching the rental finish. Preserve the exact canvas aspect ratio, ALL outer silhouette points, floor-plan polygons, all partitions and doorway gaps, staircase footprint and stair count, existing tiny garden shrubs and every colored zone boundary. Keep wall heights fixed, including low cutaway partitions; show substantial thickness by softly shaded bevelled caps and continuous fine oak skirting ON existing faces, not by changing geometry. Individually defined honey-oak planks with subtle directional wood grain in timber rooms; fine matte ceramic tiles and grout in existing tiled/bath zones; believable short grass blades, subtle garden color variation and stone paving seams on existing garden/path zones if present. Stair treads have distinct front risers, fine wood grain and modeled edge bevels. Rich soft digital-painted texture and material depth, never broad flat swatches or uniform noisy fill. Warm cream plaster, honey oak, sage and pale teal family. Lighting strictly upper-left, thin same-tone contours, no external shadow. Absolutely empty: do not add furniture, windows, plumbing, plants or decorations absent from target. Do not copy any furniture or UI icons from references. Do not move, widen or close any door opening or relocate any wall. Do not zoom, crop or recenter. Same 2:1 isometric projection, true transparent exterior, no text, logo, watermark or border.
